title: Google Drive File
description: JSON Schema for a Google Drive file resource as returned by the Google Drive REST API v3.

mimeType.description: The MIME type of the file.

parents.description: The IDs of the parent folders containing the file.

createdTime.description: The time at which the file was created.

modifiedTime.description: The last time the file was modified.

size.description: The size of the file's content in bytes.

trashed.description: Whether the file has been trashed.

starred.description: Whether the user has starred the file.

shared.description: Whether the file has been shared.

webViewLink.description: A link for opening the file in the relevant Google editor or viewer.

webContentLink.description: A link for downloading the content of the file.

iconLink.description: A static, unauthenticated link to the file's icon.
